# Assay README Template

## Assay Title

T3-dependent gene expression

## Assay Description

Gene expression of KLF9 via qPCR in SK-N-AS cells.
Characterisation for KLF9 expression in SK-N-AS cells was perfgormed with 0-1000 pM T3 
Relative gene expression was calculated using the 2−ΔΔCt -method. Data were normalized to GAPDH and shown as fold change vs. solvent control.  

Reference compounds tested: NH-3
EDCs tested: silychristin, Tetrabromobisphenol A

## File Organization
[Briefly explain how do the files in the folder relate to eachother]

The paper has two parts: characterisation of deiodinase (D3) activity of two intact cell lines (MO3.13, SK-N-AS) and testing reference compounds of EDCs. 
assay4_characterisation: processed and raw data files of characterisation KLF9 expression in SK-N-AS cells
assay4:_EDCs: processed and raw data files of endocrine disrupting chemicals tested in the assay for KLF9 expression in SK-N-AS cells
